root_cause.text: Caching pointers to IPv6 header source and destination addresses before a pskb_pull() call in icmpv6_rcv() can lead to use-after-free because skb->head may be reallocated, invalidating the cached pointers.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "Caching saddr and daddr before pskb_pull() is problematic since skb->head can change." The patch removes these cached pointers and directly accesses &ipv6_hdr(skb)->saddr and &ipv6_hdr(skb)->daddr each time they are used.
